risk_summary: The company reports negative working capital of $1.21 million, an accumulated deficit of $11.38 million, operating cash usage of $1.17 million, and only approximately six months of funding without additional capital. Although margins and gross profit improved, revenue declined and continued operations and growth depend materially on successful equity or debt financing. The disclosure is quantitatively informative but uses optimistic forward-looking language and repeated cautionary disclaimers to frame substantial liquidity risk.
